verdict.root_cause: The page treated the submitted text `<s>mug</s>` as HTML. As a result, the angle brackets disappeared and “mug” was displayed with a line through it rather than as literal text.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause this outcome. It reached the search URL with the requested query URL-encoded (`%3Cs%3Emug%3C%2Fs%3E`), and the displayed heading visibly rendered that query as struck-through text instead of literal characters. The failure is in how the application displays the supplied query.
